turns.reply:
`Segment.split_cells` no longer returns a left piece wider than the cut point: when the initial character-index estimate overshoots, `_split_cells` in `rich/segment.py` now steps `pos` back until the prefix fits.

I checked this with a randomized comparison over mixed-width strings: the left piece was never wider than the cut and never more than one cell short, and the 29 existing `split` tests in `tests/test_segment.py` pass. I did not reproduce the exact Textual #5090 scenario, and the hidden tests were not run, so the fix is verified only against the cases I generated.
